reviews.comment: Worst prof I had

Don't take his 364.
You are facing 3 exams, 6 quizzes, and 2 group projects. Meanwhile, he's an awful teacher. His lectures are useless.
Fire Gray Thomas.
Tenure Gray Thomas.

One of the most lackluster classes I've ever taken. First exam was so bad everybody got between 70 and 90 because of the curve. Never published solutions to multiple HWs and one quiz out of 6 was insanely tough. Overall you can get an A if you put in the work but he teaches practically nothing and expects you to do well on everything anyway.

Not the best teacher yet but definitely could be. This was his first semester teaching MEEN 364 so he didn't know our skill level yet. The projects were hard but pretty cool and that was the most important part about learning in this course. He definitely should do the homework and practice exams before he posts them though. I would take him again.

Lectures are the most unhelpful thing in the world. Does not relate at all to hw or exams. Quizzes are just 1 question taken from the hw but if you don't know how to do the hw then you have no luck. First exam had to get curved so heavily but at least he tries to curve so that the majority of the class passes. This guy doesn't know how to teach

MEEN 364. DO NOT TAKE. Other section actually has a teacher that knows how to teach. This guy clearly only cares about his research and not teaching. You know it bad when the whole class is complaining to each other and no one knows wtf is happening
Nice homework solutions dude! fantastic free body diagrams and steps to solve! Totally not just giving the answer to the problem!!!!!!

For his MEEN364 Controls class. This guy is not here to teach. Everyone in lecture just sits on their phones because no one can understand his lectures. He assigns work before going over it himself. Most confusing class I have ever sat through. Genuinely made a rate my professor account just so I can warn people to not take this guy.

Dr. Thomas is a phenomenal professor. At first the class was a bit disorienting and worrying but as the semester went on it became clear that if you do the work and study the practice exams, you will be fine. Dr. T is a very caring and understanding professor. I highly recommend talking to him and your TA if you are stuck on any material.

I guarantee those who rated Dr. Thomas a 1 star earlier this sem would've gotten an A in the class had they not Q-dropped. He curves tests like crazy and will literally tell you how to solve a problem on the test if you ask him. He's super chill and obviously cares about his students a lot. Take him if you can, the hate is definitely unwarranted.

Great guy. Only issue people rly have with him/the class is that its flipped - so you dont learn much in lecture. Do your hw, go to class, try on the projects, and do the practice exams and you should get a high B or low A
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Thomas is a good professor. 225 can be a lot of work because it's a flipped class. You're responsible for learning the material and doing homework/projects outside of class. In class you do practice problems where Dr. T would always be willing to help. Can be confusing because his methods don't always align with the videos but still a great guy.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is a nice person and has done a decent job at facilitating the class. Lectures aren't what I expected going into it, but I understand that it's a flipped learning class. I've had to ask for help on homework a couple of times and he helped me out pretty well. I just wish he worked out some of the problems for the learning catalytics

This "flipped" learning class means watching youtube videos of a Professor from Texas Tech and spending 4 hours a week on practice problems that he doesn't explain the process of solving. Literal nightmare of a class and he can't explain simple concepts- straight from Grad school and can't teach if his life depended on it. Plus, awful projects.
He is a very nice man. Unfortunately he got thrown into this position, and he is definitely still learning how to be a prof. Give him 2/3 years and he will be a 4-5/5
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is "flipped" which means you only do practice problems in class 4 hours a week. All lecture material is outside of class and you have to watch 1.5-3 hours per lecture plus reading nearly 100 pages in the text book per week. It is obvious that this professor was thrown into this class just days before school started.

This professor isn't even a professor. There is a obvious lack of actual material being taught and learned within the lectures. In class examples are typically worked incorrectly leaving us confused after class. I am teaching myself the material outside of class, rather than learning inside of class and practicing outside of class.

Not a professor. Another case of a researcher turned professor with zero teaching experience due to the overpopulated MEEN department. Learned nothing in class, had to learn through YouTube videos. Horrible at explaining simple concepts.
